ResearchTabDef.label: goblin
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Crude but effective goblin crafts: bone, alloy, blackpowder, and flesh. Cheaper than proper scholarship — goblins learn by doing, eating, and exploding.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bone rendering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grind bones into stabilizer dust, stack humanlike bones into crude but sturdy walls, and shape them into the first goblin weapons and armor. The most basic of goblin material crafts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin alloying
ResearchProjectDef.description: Smelt scrap metals with bone dust stabilizer into crude and standard goblin alloys — the backbone of all goblin metalwork.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin smithcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Forge goblin-alloy blades, spears, maces and medieval-grade armor at the goblin smithbench.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin armorcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Hammer goblin alloy into chainmail, breastplates, scale coats, helmets and sturdy shields.

ResearchProjectDef.label: elite forging
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine superior goblin alloy and forge elite war-gear: plate armor, banner spears, reinforced shields, war banners, flails and machetes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin blackpowder
ResearchProjectDef.description: Mix volatile goblin blackpowder and fit crude firearms: arquebuses, matchlocks and handgonnes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced gunpowder
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stronger charges and heavier barrels: goblin handcannons and advanced gunpowder weaponry.

ResearchProjectDef.label: boomsticks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Strap a blackpowder charge to a stick. What could go wrong? Unlocks goblin boomstick weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin crossbows
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fit a bow sideways onto a stock with a trigger. Unlocks the goblin crossbow.

ResearchProjectDef.label: repeating crossbows
ResearchProjectDef.description: A bolt magazine and a lever: the goblin repeating crossbow.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin stewpot
ResearchProjectDef.description: A great communal pot for simmering stews. Unlocks the goblin stewpot.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin cuisine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refined goblin cookery: sausages, brain stews, limb roasts and lavish flesh platters that sharpen goblin minds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin butchery
ResearchProjectDef.description: The savored disassembly of humanlike bodies: better yields of flesh and bone, done with unsettling appreciation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fleshcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Precise extraction of organs, brains and flesh — for the stewpot, the altar, and the skin-mask.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pheromone craft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Distill goblin gland secretions into combat and toxic pheromones, and the packs that spread them. Requires the goblin alchemy table.

ResearchProjectDef.label: goblin war-brews
ResearchProjectDef.description: Goblin alchemy: combat drugs, foul concoctions, stink weaponry and the shaman's staff. Unlocks the goblin alchemy table.
